title: PhishGuard++
summary: A multi-tier phishing detection system that cascades edge, cloud, and LLM (Gemini) intelligence for real-time URL classification. Its data pipeline module trains an sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata object to augment tabular phishing-URL training data, so SDV's CTGAN synthesizer is run as part of the data augmentation stage.
